title: Motion Transformer with Global Intention Localization and Local Movement Refinement
layout_note: Encoder stage in the centre and decoder stage on the right placed side by side, each read bottom-to-top, with the scene encoding strip at the far left.
grouping: Left strip: a top-down map scene -> 'Polyline Encoder' -> the same scene as a local graph, read top to bottom. Centre: token rows and grey modules read bottom to top, with two dashed blue containers (a) and (b) each holding a module plus a top-view mini-scene of its output. Right: a dashed blue container (c) on a grey background holds the decoder layer with 'xN', its inputs along the bottom and outputs along the top. A glyph legend runs along the bottom of the whole figure.
shapes_depth: Modules are flat grey rectangles with thin outlines; tensors are white rounded boxes with shape labels written as math (K x T x 2, K x (2+2), K x D). Token rows are white rounded bars holding blue squares (agent features) and grey circles (map features). Mini-scenes are top-view lane sketches with car sprites (green = agent of interest, grey = others), predicted trajectories as dotted yellow arrows, and trajectory-specific map regions as translucent coloured bands. Serif labels; straight orthogonal arrows with labels such as 'Key & Value'.
proposed_highlight: The proposed parts are the dashed blue containers (a), (b), (c); each of (a) and (b) pairs its module box with a mini-scene of what it produces, and (c) expands the decoder on a grey ground.
lesson: Use two token glyphs (blue squares for agents, grey circles for map polylines) in every token row, and pair each module with a top-view mini-scene showing its output as dotted trajectory arrows and translucent map bands, all decoded by a glyph legend along the bottom.
notes: Venue and year from the PDF first page ('36th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2022)'; venue_source: pdf). Method short name MTR from the caption.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
